ridership_impact.methodology: 1.49 min wait saved × 3× wait-time premium (2-5× per Pratt 1999 / VTPI) = 4.47 in-vehicle minutes per trip = 12.77% of an assumed 35-min trip × travel-time elasticity -0.13 (Dowling 2005, Portland) = ~1.66% ridership gain (plausible band 0.33-8.94% across the literature's premium, elasticity and trip-length ranges) with no added buses or drivers.

fleet_feasibility.detail: Vehicle-block layover enforced across 84 interlining edges (min 8 min). Baseline violations: 34; after optimization: 34. GTFS block_id models vehicle interlining; driver shift/roster blocks are not in GTFS and are proxied by the layover standard.
